_readme: Messages in chats listed in `internalChatIds` are: (1) posted to platform `/api/otp/official` so login codes are stored for the logged-in website user, (2) optionally saved to the internal archive server (`npm run archive:serve`) when `archiveApiUrl` is set, kept readable for `deleteDelaySeconds`, then deleted from Telegram for all participants. Archive is best-effort: deletion still runs if the archive server is unreachable. On every login/reconnect the latest 100 messages of each internal chat are swept. Ids use the same format as in hiddenChats.json. Rebuild the app after editing.
